case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
